settings.title: SALON MATS
Beauty meets comfort in our salon mats, offering a plush platform for stylists to stand on as they transform their clients' looks.
Comfort Craft Salon Mats
settings.text:
• Lasting Elegance: Designed not just to look good but made to last with a focus on durability, these mats can withstand the rigors of daily salon use while maintaining their elegant appearance.

  • Stylish Design: With a sleek and modern aesthetic, these mats add a touch of sophistication to any salon.

  • Comfort Meets Durability: While they excel in style, these mats don't compromise on comfort. They provide ample cushioning and support for salon professionals during long hours of service.

Starting at $5.00/sq ft.

settings.title: Reflex Salon Mats
settings.text:
• Dual-Action Support: Feature a unique blend of sponge and vertical column support that enhance blood circulation and reduce muscle fatigue.

  • Promotes Wellness: The super resilient closed-cell polymeric sponge base encourages leg and calf movement, relieving tension from standing long periods of time.

  • Custom Comfort: Choose from the Single Sponge style at 9/16” thickness for everyday comfort or the Double Sponge style at a full 1” thickness for double the support and fatigue relief.

Starting at $4.50/sq ft.
